name: The Narrator
description: An unnamed survivor of Duskmourn who keeps a dining room in the Boilerbilge and coaxes guests to sit and stay so the House will leave them be.

timeline.summary: The narrator greets new arrivals in the parlor and invites them to sit, promising only a moment's rest.
timeline.quote: You're safe here, for the moment.

timeline.summary: The narrator explains that Duskmourn is both the world and the House.
timeline.quote: The House is the world, the world is the House, and the word for both is Duskmourn

timeline.summary: The narrator reveals the guests are trapped by the chairs they sat in willingly, and that the House will take its first bites of them.
timeline.quote: if I can convince people not to fight it long enough for it to take the first few bites, it lets me keep my little space

timeline.summary: The narrator bids farewell, staying behind as the House feeds on the guests.
timeline.quote: As long as I can keep feeding my dining hall, it won't feel the need to feed on me.

relations.note: Survives in the House by feeding it guests.
relations.quote: I was clever enough to learn how to survive in here
